title: Handle unreadable JSON
summary: WebSockets: Handle unreadable JSON. Send {} instead.
introduction: JSON.parse can fail. A catch block sends a friendly reply instead of crashing this handler.

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Handle unreadable JSON

blocks.text: The invalid text makes JSON.parse throw. The catch branch sends the guide message.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Catch the parse failure and then check the parsed data shape separately.
